phase: selected and frozen before fresh evaluation outcomes
source_of_exclusions: recorded reservation_source_files and excluded_rosters in teams.json

schedule_design.kind: four-game blocks: both simulator sides and both bot/team assignments
schedule_design.source_and_prior_manifest: not frozen yet; requires selected candidate

primary_comparison: selected revised prior versus frozen current MCTS with existing usage prior
secondary_comparison: required direct60-game comparison vsfirstmixture, samefixedcandidate andreservedschedule

stopping_rule.voids: record explicitly; never silently omit or relabel draws

fit_rule: Do not tune the candidate with these new reserved team pastes or game outcomes. Old v1 battles are development history.
promotion: Offline prediction gain alone is insufficient. Record playing results, uncertainty, reliability and failures. Keep default unchanged unless evidence supports a separately documented promotion.
separation: No edits to original OxHack-2026 checkout or other-chat source; no cross-chat messages sent.
limits: Not an independent external set holdout. Component sets are known, and overlap with source-wide usage cannot be excluded.
